description: Test suite for the LRU cache implementation in the Mattermost server, including tests for eviction, expiration, marshaling, race conditions, and various data types.

methods.name: TestLRU
methods.description: Tests basic LRU cache operations including insertion, eviction, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: TestLRUExpire
methods.description: Tests expiration behavior of cache entries based on default expiry settings.

methods.name: TestLRUMarshalUnMarshal
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of complex data types stored in the cache.

methods.name: BenchmarkLRU
methods.description: Benchmarks cache performance with simple strings, complex objects, and user data.

methods.name: TestLRURace
methods.description: Tests concurrent access to the cache to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: TestLRURace
methods.description: Tests concurrent set and get operations to verify race condition handling.
